Class SentenceAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.nonsense.utils.SentenceAnalyzer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class SentenceAnalyzer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A service for analyzing sentence structure and content using Google Cloud Natural Language API. Provides functionality for toxicity detection, syntactic analysis, and dictionary management. Implements AutoCloseable to ensure proper resource cleanup.

      public float getToxicityScore(String sentence)

      sentence - The text to analyze for toxic content
      Returns:
      A score between 0 (non-toxic) and 1 (highly toxic)
